data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 48.098 million in 2018. This adverse development was primarily attributed to the ongoing impact of natural catastrophe events from 2017, specifically the September 2017 storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean and two earthquakes in Mexico, collectively known as the "HIMM" losses.

adverse impact in 2017 of the storm and earthquake losses experienced in the third quarter
data.data_quality_notes: There are conflicting figures for prior year development in the report. The 'Change in prior year provisions' from the Technical Provisions note (page 19) has been used as the primary source, as it directly refers to the movement in reserve provisions and balances the reconciliation table. This figure is a strengthening of GBP 48.098m. The 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years' from the Claims Outstanding note (page 16) shows a strengthening of GBP 31.366m. A calculation from the gross claims development triangle (page 18) for underwriting years <= 2016 indicates a release of GBP 31.637m. The narrative supports a strengthening due to 2017 catastrophe events.
